judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), an incomplete specification (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and two failing acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`). It did not implement any of the actual production code in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or add `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, the new tests in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when run because `ToolRegistry.execute` still invokes the executor without validating input. None of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts`, orchestrator tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, or documentation updates (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`) were produced.
